tools.name: search_resorts
tools.description: Find ski resorts worldwide by name, country or distance. Returns at most 20 matches and does not expose the bulk resort index.

tools.name: get_conditions
tools.description: Get current snow, reported lift and run counts, weather and season state. Lift and run counts are reported status, not guaranteed live.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get the available daily snow, temperature, freezing level and wind-hold risk forecast, up to 10 requested days.

tools.name: plan_my_day
tools.description: Build modelled suggested runs in time order from forecast weather, sun, snow and mapped terrain. Only plans days inside the reported winter season; summer lift or bike-park operation does not count as open for skiing. Easy, intermediate and advanced exclude expert, freeride and extreme terrain; only

tools.name: sun_on_the_mountain
tools.description: Show modelled sun and shade windows for eight slope aspects, with local terrain-horizon shading where DEM coverage exists.

tools.name: route_on_mountain
tools.description: Route between named pistes, lifts, the resort base or latitude,longitude coordinates using mapped OSM pistes and lifts. Names match accent-insensitively and partially (exact, then prefix, then contained words); a piste or lift split into several connected OSM pieces counts as one. A lift used as fro

tools.name: avalanche_danger
tools.description: Summarise the regional avalanche bulletin covering a resort: EAWS in Europe, avalanche.org centres in the US and Avalanche Canada, with zone, issuing centre, issue and expiry times and a link to the official forecast. Expired products are never shown as current. Never substitutes for the official bu

tools.name: mountain_facts
tools.description: Read mapped OSM terrain inventory, lift fleet, vertical, longest run, carefully matched Wikidata facts, season dates and modelled snow reliability.

tools.name: where_is_it_snowing
tools.description: Rank the freshest recently reported snow from the cached EM Snow home-page ranking.

tools.name: best_time_to_go
tools.description: Get historical snow odds from the local ERA5 archive and quiet-week guidance where the crowd scorer covers the resort.

tools.name: season_recap
tools.description: Summarise the most recent completed ski season from the local ERA5 archive first.

tools.name: snow_reliability
tools.description: Get an explainable snow-reliability score from long-run ERA5 snow depth.

tools.name: nearby_resorts
tools.description: Find nearby resorts from the local EM Snow resort index.

tools.name: get_webcams
tools.description: Get nearby webcam images and their source links, with the required provider credit.

tools.name: get_snow_reports
tools.description: Get recent visible community reports, including whether each came from the website or was relayed by an AI assistant.

tools.name: watch_resort
tools.description: Return a one-tap EM Snow URL where the person can watch a resort and optionally add dates. This tool does not collect email.

tools.name: add_snow_report
tools.description: Only relay a report from a person who is at, or was just at, the resort. Never invent a report. The report goes live immediately and is labelled as relayed via an AI assistant.

tools.name: suggest_resort
tools.description: Suggest a missing resort for human review. This never adds it directly to the resort index.

tools.name: get_extended_outlook
tools.description: Get a 16-day daily outlook (snowfall, temperatures, freezing level, maximum gusts and, for the first days, precipitation probability) from EM Snow's self-hosted GFS and ECMWF IFS models. Days 1 to 7 overlap get_forecast; days 8 to 16 are low-confidence trend guidance only.

tools.name: get_resort_media
tools.description: Get images for a resort that vision-capable assistants can show: nearby webcams with provider credit, a Wikimedia Commons photo with its per-file licence, author and source page, the EM Snow sun and shade teaser where one exists, and the resort page link. No trail-map image is available.

tools.name: fly_this_mountain
tools.description: Get a link that plays a simulated 3D tour of a resort in the EM Snow flyby (lifts up, named runs down, on the mapped piste network), or a tour of runs you name. findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "route_on_mountain" is 648 chars, far longer than this server's median (124). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "add_snow_report" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
